tobs_minigames
==============

1. Put the "tobs_minigames" folder in your resources folder.
2. Add this line to server.cfg:   ensure tobs_minigames
3. Restart the server and type /minigame in game to try every minigame.

No framework, database, items or other resources needed. Settings: tobs_minigames/config.lua
For script makers: tobs_minigames/EXPORTS.md


Optional: [tobs_minigames-compat]
---------------------------------

Only if your server runs qb-minigames, memorygame, mhacking or safecracker (the server console
tells you at start). For each one:

1. Delete the original folder (for example "safecracker").
2. Copy the folder with the same name from [tobs_minigames-compat] into your resources folder.
3. Ensure it after tobs_minigames in server.cfg.

The scripts that used the original then play tobs_minigames' games, without any edits.
If you don't use those resources, you can ignore or delete [tobs_minigames-compat].
